messages:
maya: partner-ops flagged a big spike in billed usage that lines up with their replay window. They say they send cumulative counters per device, but we appear to have treated them as deltas.
aj: Can you paste the sample they sent?
maya: Partner example (redacted): ```{
  "device_id": "dev-9001",
  "account_id": "acct_PARTNERY",
  "ts": "2026-04-10T02:00:00Z",
  "cumulative_total_seconds": 1254.72,
  "seq": 102
}``` They said previous checkpoint was 1200.12s and they replayed seq 101-103, but our invoiced delta looks like +1254.72 for each replay.
suresh: That matches a classic cumulative-vs-delta interpretation bug. If our parser treats incoming cumulative_total as a per-interval delta, replayed messages get double-counted.
oliver: Do we currently require an event type or a field indicating cumulative vs delta? I don't think so for the SI connector because of legacy devices.
emily: Partner used to send deltas, recently switched to cumulative for reliability on flaky networks and forgot to tell us. They replayed a backlog and assumed idempotency.
aj: Short-term: add a dedupe rule that if cumulative_total < last_seen_cumulative for same device, ignore (or require operator review). Also, if cumulative_total > last_seen, compute delta = cumulative_total - last_seen and bill delta.
suresh: Implementation: persist last_cumulative per device/account (int microseconds) and seq number. On ingest: if seq <= last_seq ignore; else if cumulative provided, compute delta = max(0, cumulative - last_cumulative) and store cumulative/seq. If delta > threshold (e.g., >24h) flag for manual review.
metering-bot: Created ticket PD-13000: "cumulative counter replay causing duplicated billed deltas - acct_PARTNERY" assigned to @aj (P1).
aj: I'll push a small parser patch to detect presence of cumulative_total_* fields and switch to cumulative logic. Will add unit tests for replay and seq out-of-order. Plan: branch today, staging tomorrow, canary with one partner stream Thu.
emily: Partner asked for credits for the last invoice. We need to compute precise diffs: reprocess raw events using cumulative semantics and diff billed vs corrected. Billing-ops, want us to run a bulk reconciliation?
billing-ops: yes, please provide CSV of impacted accounts + invoice IDs + suggested credit amount. We'll validate and issue credits after legal review.
maya: Acceptance criteria: 1) parser supports cumulative_total ingestion with stored last_cumulative + seq; 2) ingestor ignores or dedupes seq <= last_seq; 3) reconciliation tool to reprocess raw payloads and emit diffs; 4) partner schema guidance updated to prefer deltas OR include explicit "counter_type": "cumulative|delta".
suresh: I'll add regression tests including partial replay, out-of-order seq, and device resets (when cumulative decreases): treat as reset and bill cumulative as new base, but mark event for manual review.
aj: I'll attach PR link and canary plan to PD-13000 when ready.
metering-bot: PD-13000 updated with backfill run scheduled for 2026-04-12.
maya: Great. Also add monitoring metric: "cumulative-replay-anomalies" per partner and alert at >0.05% events flagged. We'll follow up with partner onboarding docs to require seq/event_id and explicit counter_type.
emily: I'll draft the partner message offering provisional credit and timeline after we have the reconciliation CSV.
aj: noted. I'll kick off the reprocess job once parser patch lands in staging.
maya: thanks team. :white_check_mark:
